english.note: This is the all-purpose casual term for a pedicure, especially one focused on trimming and beautifying the toenails.

examples.english: I usually go to a beauty salon for a pedicure and have my toenails tidied up.
examples.traditional: 我通常去美容院修腳，順便整靚啲腳甲。
